maria (Docs): Quick thread — tiny docs follow-up for the streaming/pagination snippets. Need: jittered retry examples, explicit resume-token TTL mention, and a one-paragraph fallback to polling pages. Keep each snippet <=8 lines.

sam (SDK): Ill coordinate. Which paths?

maria (Docs): docs/snippets/sdk/streaming/*, examples/get-started/stream-paginate/README.md, and a one-line note in docs/guides/pagination.md. Add one short line about batch_size trade-offs.

eli (PY SDK): Pushed a short python example with jittered backoff + resume token save. Example: ```py
retry = Retry(jitter=True, base=0.1, max=1.5)
for ch in client.stream(req, retry=retry):
  if getattr(ch, 'resume_token', None): save(ch.resume_token)
  print(ch.text)
```

linda (TS SDK): TS async-iterator added, typed resumeToken: string | undefined. ```ts
for await (const p of client.stream(req)) { if (p.resumeToken) store(p.resumeToken); console.log(p.text) }
```

jon (Go eng): Go snippet pushed: context timeout + reconnect hint. Keep it tiny.

maria (Docs): Editorial asks: 1) add exact sentence: "Resume tokens expire after 24 hours; persist tokens if you may resume." 2) include a tiny pseudocode fallback: ```pseudo
while has_more: page = client.list_pages(cursor); process(page); cursor = page.next_cursor
``` 3) one-line: "set batch_size for throughput vs latency trade-offs."
